Burning Hands (O1 Evoc): 15' cone inflicts 5d4 HP fire (save Reflex half)
Elemental Body I (Form Of Flame4 Tran): Self becomes a Small elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +2 Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +2 Strength, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +2 Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +2 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision
Elemental Body II (Form Of Flame5 Tran): Self becomes a Medium elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +4 Dexterity, a +3 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +4 Strength, a +5 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +4 Dexterity, a +3 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +4 Constitution, a +5 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision
Elemental Body III (Form Of Flame6 Tran): Self becomes a Large elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +2 Strength; +4 Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +6 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +2 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +6 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision and immunity to bleed damage, critical hits, and Sneak Attack
Elemental Body IV (Form Of Flame7 Tran): Self becomes a Huge elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +4 Strength; +6 Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 120' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +8 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +6 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +4 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +8 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision, immunity to bleed damage, critical hits, and Sneak Attack, and DR 5/-
Fiery Body (O9 Tran): Gives self immunity to fire, blindness, critical hits, ability damage, deafness, disease, drowning, poison, stunning, and physiology spells, half damage from acid or electricity, +6 Dexterity, a 40' fly Speed, brightness that dazzles viewers, +1 fire spell DC, and unarmed attacks that inflict +3d6 HP fire, regains hit points instead of suffering damage from fire attacks (regains 1 hit point per 3 HP damage), suffers x1.5 HP from cold, and suffers 2d6 HP each rd in water while gaining a 50% miss chance, for 20 min
Fire Seeds (O6 Conj): Changes 4 touched acorns into grenades that can be thrown with a 20' range increment for ranged touch attacks that inflict 20d4 HP fire in total (the most powerful can inflict at most 10d4 HP), plus 1 HP of splash per die, or 8 touched holly berries into bombs that detonate on command to inflict 1d8+20 HP fire in a 5' radius each (save Reflex half), for 200 min
Fire Storm (O8 Evoc): R300' 40 10' cubes inflict 20d6 HP fire, then 4d6 HP fire each rd until extinguished (save Reflex inflicts half initial HP only)
Fireball (O3 Evoc): R1200' Inflicts 10d6 HP fire in a 20' radius (save Reflex half)
Incendiary Cloud (O8 Conj): R300' Fire in a 20' radius, 20'-high cylinder obscures vision, inflicts 6d6 HP fire (save Reflex half), and moves away 10' per rd (or up to 60' with concentration) for 20 rd
Resist Energy (O2 Abju): Touched gains resistance 30 to a choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic for 200 min (save Fortitude negates)
Summon Monster V (O5 Conj): R75' Summons 1 5th-level, 1d3 4th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
Wall Of Fire (O4 Evoc): R300' Creates a 400'x20' wall or a 50'x20' ring that inflicts 2d4 HP fire to creatures within 10' of a chosen side, 1d4 HP fire to creatures within 20', and 2d6+20 HP fire when passing through (or double these damages to undead) for concentration + 20 rd
Magic Notes:
Charisma Oracle Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level O1, O2, O3
Spell Focus (Enchantment): +1 Spell DC (Enchantment)
Burning Magic: Successful fire spell inflicts 1 HP/spell level fire for 1d4 rd (spell DC Reflex ends)
Elemental Focus (Acid): +1 save DC on spells that inflict acid damage
Elemental Spell (Cold): May use +1 spell slot to convert half or all spell damage to cold damage
Empower Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal to increase its variable effects by 50%
Final Revelation (Flame Mystery): May apply Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell to fire spells w/out cost
Form Of Flame: May use Elemental Body IV effects to become huge fire elemental for 20 hr 1/dy
Gaze Of Flames: R200' Can see out of any flame in range 20 rd/dy
Haunted: Knows Mage Hand, Ghost Sound, Levitate, Minor Image, Telekinesis, Reverse Gravity spells
Maximize Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to maximize all of its variable effects
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Persistent Spell: May spend +2 spell slot to force target to take worse of 2 saving throws
Quicken Spell: Once per rd, can cast a spell with a casting time of up to 1 rd as a free action, using a spell slot 4 levels higher than normal
Reach Spell: May cast touch, close, or medium range spell at longer range; uses +1 spell slot/range increase
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
